```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(openxlsx)

# Leer el Excel
df <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("var.xlsx")

# Convertir a formato largo
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(C.index, IBS, AUC),  # columnas métricas
               names_to = "Métrica",
               values_to = "Valor")

# Paleta personalizada por métrica
colores_metricas <- c(
  "C.index" = "#F96B04",
  "IBS" = "#37B0B4",
  "AUC" = "#E4B815"
)

# ============================
# GRAFICOS POR CLASE – SLP
# ============================
df_slp <- df_long %>% filter(VARIABLE == "SLP")

ggplot(df_slp, aes(x = MODELO, y = Valor, fill = Métrica)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Valor, 2)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colores_metricas) +
  labs(title = "Supervivencia libre de progresión (SLP)",
       x = "Modelo", y = "Valor de la métrica") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# ============================
# GRAFICOS POR CLASE – SG
# ============================
df_sg <- df_long %>% filter(VARIABLE == "SG")

ggplot(df_sg, aes(x = MODELO, y = Valor, fill = Métrica)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Valor, 2)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colores_metricas) +
  labs(title = "Supervivencia global (SG)",
       x = "Modelo", y = "Valor de la métrica") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
